notes:
What's new in this update:
- In-app updates now run through our own update server instead of Firebase — faster, more reliable version checks.
- Added a dedicated Updates page (Home > Updates, or the refresh icon in the top bar) to check your version, see what changed, and install with a visible download progress bar.
- GSTR-2B Tally import: confirmed suppliers missing from Tally are auto-created as ledgers under Sundry Creditors during import, using the GSTIN on the invoice.
